This plugin served the same need through"},{"id":"p2s4","text":" `conversation.input.dock`, so the repository is frozen."},{"id":"p3s1","text":"中文 | English"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"task-status"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Background task status bar: task-progress UI above the chat input area — running count + expandable "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"details + live output tail"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"A background-task status bar above the chat input box: running-task count + click-to-expand per-task"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" details + **live output tail** (auto-polling, 10-line scrolling area). Registered through the offic"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"ial `conversation.input.dock` slot (same family as queue/todo/goal). Ships as an official **bundle p"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"lugin** (`dsh.bundle` + dshClient channel), 0 patches."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Preview"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**UI** (chat-page dock slot):"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Feature | Description |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Status bar | Dock card above the chat input box: `⚙ N background tasks running` |
| Expandable det"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"ails | Click a task row to expand: status / duration / details + output tail |
| Live tail | Polls t"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"he output route every 1s while expanded, re-rendering the whole block (the mirror patch guarantees z"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"ero contention with the official `task_output` tool and a consistent view) |
| Scrolling area | Outp"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"ut area capped at 10 lines (160px); overflow becomes a scrollbar (tail keeps the end, scrollable to "},{"id":"p11s6","text":"review) |
| Chat page only | Automatically hidden on non-Chat views (trajectory / taskboard, etc.) |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**Routes** (Node half):"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Route | Description |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| `/plugins/dsh-task-status/tasks` | Task list (read-only, filtered by session; owned + unowned unio"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"n) |
| `/plugins/dsh-task-status/output` | Task output tail (`full:true` accumulates the full text; "},{"id":"p14s3","text":"h-task-status/output` | Task output tail (`full:true` accumulates the full text; unknown id → 404) |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"**Output tail contention semantics** (official 0809 API constraint): `tasks.read` is a consumptive, "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"incremental read (one shared cursor per task). This plugin applies a **mirror patch** to `ctx.tasks."},{"id":"p15s3","text":"read` — the official read becomes buffered mirror (increments already read by others, not re-consume"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"d) + direct read of the latest (normal consumption); the plugin's own reads go straight to the under"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"lying rawRead. The official tool and the plugin see the same increment sequence (no duplicates, no l"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"oss); only the proactively self-read part can no longer be replayed by the official side alone (offi"},{"id":"p15s7","text":"cial semantics is inherently incremental, so model perception is unaffected)."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"**Recommended: one-line install from a git source** (build artifacts are committed; a git source doe"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"sn't trigger a build):"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Or from a local directory (when you have the source): `git clone`, then `cd dsh-task-status && dsh p"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"lugin --profile web add .`."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"After installing, **restart web** for it to take effect; you can disable/enable it in the "Plugins" "},{"id":"p20s2","text":"panel on the settings page."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Run a background task and the status bar appears (e.g. the model-side `bash` tool with `run_in_backg"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"nd task and the status bar appears (e.g. the model-side `bash` tool with `run_in_background: true`):"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Click a task row to expand → the output tail scrolls live (a scrollbar appears once it exceeds 10 li"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"nes). The status bar disappears automatically when the task finishes."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- Node half: `src/index.mjs` (mirror patch + `/tasks` `/output` routes)
- client: `src/client/task-s"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"tatus.tsx` (dock-slot status bar)"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"MIT License (example plugin in the DSH ecosystem)."}],"truncated":false}
